subject: OptiCloud — VPC/private deployment interest & next steps
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@opticloud.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & proposed next steps — VPC/private deployment for OptiCloud

Hi Natalie,

Nice to meet today — thanks for the time. Quick recap from our call and a suggested path forward if OptiCloud wants to evaluate a private/VPC deployment: 

- Goal you shared: host sensitive inference workloads in a customer-managed VPC with control-plane isolation and KMS integration; primary use case is internal document summarization and agent orchestration.
- Key constraints: SOC 2 + enterprise procurement, tight data residency for EU customers (but your initial scope is US), and a Q2 launch target for a pilot with 5 engineers.

What we discussed: Redwood Private supports VPC peering, customer-managed KMS, and an on-prem package if you need air-gapped options. For a quick technical validation we typically run a 2-week pilot (env in your VPC, limited traffic, basic SLA) + a 45-minute workshop with one of our solution architects.

Suggested next steps (pick one):
1) Schedule 45-minute technical workshop (deep dive on networking, KMS, deployment topology) — ideal for engineering + infra.
2) Kick off two-week pilot (we handle the deployment guidance) — best to validate perf/cost quickly.
3) If procurement needs materials, I can share a short SOW + pricing band for dedicated capacity.

Attachments: Redwood_Private_Options.pdf (concise spec + deployment checklist).

Ask: can you confirm (a) priority for this work relative to other Q2 projects, and (b) who on your side should join the workshop (engineering, security, procurement)? If it helps, I can propose two times next week.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Soojín Lee
Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
